paper: Gaussian Mean Field Variational Inference can Overestimate Predictive Variance

claims.text: MFVI can underestimate posterior variance in parameter space while overestimating predictive variance relative to the exact posterior.

claims.anchor: Expected predictive variance on the training distribution
claims.text: For test points drawn from the training distribution, MFVI's expected predictive variance exceeds the exact posterior's.
The predictive-variance overestimation occurs in directions where the training data concentrates.
